title: Twin Babies Sitting on Rocky Ground, 1940s California B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot showing two young infants, likely fraternal or identical twins, sitting on a sunlit, rugged hillside of rocks and gravel beside a small tree sapling and rocky outcroppings. Both babies wear matching pale rompers and soft leather baby shoes, squinting under the bright midday California sun. The verso features remnants of black album corner paper and a faint processing stamp from Whittier, California.
